verdicts.title: Current Orchestration Ownership Audit
verdicts.decision: Keep ChatGPT Supervisor as top-level orchestration owner and native Workers as specialist execution owners.

verdicts.title: Static Manifest vs Registry Crosswalk
verdicts.decision: Keep the versioned static Worker capability manifest until runtime discovery/registration becomes an execution dependency.

verdicts.title: Registry / Orchestrator Admission Gate
verdicts.decision: Keep P2 as pure selection policy; review/adopt orchestration only when dynamic coordination is a proven execution dependency; durable workflow requirements defer to REF-03C.

verdicts.title: Context Layer / Authority Crosswalk
verdicts.decision: Preserve native project/session ownership and explicit authority boundaries among task, contract, evidence, Skill, and memory.

verdicts.title: Skill Catalog v1
verdicts.decision: Use metadata-only on-demand Skill catalog semantics; concrete Skill content remains project/native-Worker-owned.

verdicts.title: Context Selection + Collision Policy
verdicts.decision: Select minimum sufficient context; fail closed on unresolved Skills; never allow Skill/Memory to override project contract or current verified evidence.

verdicts.title: Tri-worker Context / Skill Regression
verdicts.decision: Permanent deterministic regression is included in normal npm test and is green on macOS and Windows Node 24.
